notes: Hand-picked street-detail set pieces, each {id, kind, asset, xz, yaw, reason, reference}, or {id, kind, prop, params, xz, yaw, reason, reference} for a kit prop.
xz is world metres (+X east, +Z south); yaw is radians about +Y, turning the asset's -Z front.
tools/build_godot_world.mjs rejects an entry that leaves the land or enters the shared exclusion mask.

Trees are props of the street-vegetation kit (game/scripts/world/street_vegetation_kit.gd) with params {variant, scale}, where dated photos show particular trees; positions are production inference read from those photos and an undated Google satellite view (ferry-shelter-refs-20261023 shots/32-sat-canopy), not survey data. Where a tree stands in paving (the Building 1 lot edge, where the photographed bed is lot asphalt in the game) it stands in a square mulch cut-out.
